title: Juicy Caramelized British Plum Stir-fry
description: A floral and juicy post-workout dish featuring plum jam caramelization, perfect for a kosher-friendly breakfast.
instructions: Wash and pit the plums. Place them in a shallow baking dish.
Pour olive oil over the plums, then sprinkle minced garlic evenly over them. Drizzle lemon juice over the plums.
Bake for about 15 minutes or until the plums are tender when pierced with a fork and caramelized on top. Remove from oven.
Return to the stove, heat vegetable oil in a pan. Stir-fry any remaining garlic for about 20 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add caramelized plum mixture into the pan. Cook for an additional 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and plums are glossy and juicy.
Season with salt to taste, serve hot as a breakfast dish.
